source: Cheng et al., 'Thermal conductance across harmonic-matched epitaxial Al-sapphire heterointerfaces', Commun. Phys. 3, 115 (2020); arXiv:1906.05484v2 Fig. 2(c), sample Sub200 (MBE Al(111) on sapphire(0001)), TDTR round robin. Read from the raster figure by marker detection; estimated error ~2%. Authors: elastic transport dominates; G plateaus above ~300 K; AGF agrees.
units: T in K, G in MW m^-2 K^-1
notes: Authors' e-ph model used g_Al = 5.38e17 W/m3K (Jain & McGaughey PRB 93, 081206 (2016)) and kp = 6 W/mK.
